member.name: T:Microsoft.Extensions.Validation.DisplayNameInfo
member.summary: Resolves the display name of a validated member (property, parameter, or type). Each , , and may carry a single instance that encapsulates the strategy for producing its display name at validation time.

remarks.para: Implementations encode a single source of the display name (for example, a literal value from , a static resource accessor for [Display(ResourceType = ..., Name = ...)], or a custom strategy). The validation pipeline calls once per member validation and uses the result, falling back to the CLR member name when the implementation returns .

Implementations may participate in localization by inspecting on . Implementations that source their value from a static resource (the path) typically bypass because the resource lookup is the canonical source for the localized name.

member.name: T:Microsoft.Extensions.Validation.IValidationLocalizer
member.summary: Provides localization services for the validation pipeline. Implementations resolve display names (used as {0} placeholder substitutions in error messages) and localized error message text for instances. Set an instance on to enable localization.

remarks.para: The default implementation that integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.Localization.IStringLocalizer is provided by the Microsoft.Extensions.Validation.Localization package and is wired up by calling AddValidationLocalization(). Custom implementations can be supplied directly via .

Implementations may be invoked outside the validation pipeline (for example, during server-side rendering of client-side validation rules), so they must not depend on per-validation state and must be safe to call concurrently.

member.summary: Gets or sets the used by the validation pipeline to resolve localized display names and error messages.

remarks.para: When (the default), no localization is performed: literal display names from and are returned as-is, and validation error messages fall back to the attribute's default message.

To enable the default IStringLocalizer-based implementation, add a reference to Microsoft.Extensions.Validation.Localization and call services.AddValidationLocalization() during DI configuration. Alternatively, assign a custom implementation directly.
This property is intended to be configured during application startup. Mutating it after the validation pipeline has begun processing requests is not thread-safe.
